Bash(git add .github/workflows/finny-publish.yml && git commit -m "$\(cat <<'EOF'
fix: install cross-platform deps at workspace root before build

The build script's bun install runs from packages/opencode/ which may
create a separate resolution scope in the monorepo. Installing at the
workspace root ensures packages are hoisted to the same node_modules/
tree that the bundler resolves from.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git add .github/workflows/finny-publish.yml && git commit -m "$\(cat <<'EOF'
fix: use global bun install with cross-platform flags

Simplify cross-platform dep installation by running
`bun install --os="*" --cpu="*"` at the workspace root instead of
installing specific packages. This ensures ALL optional deps
\(including platform-specific ones like @opentui/core-linux-arm64\)
are installed in the same node_modules tree the bundler resolves from.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
